name: X
description: Search and draft on X; scout timeline accounts, filter countries/sources, manage optional follows, saved country cards, reusable text and profile backups.
instructions: Use the signed-in session on the exact x.com domain. Load only the requested action. Choose script for supported deterministic workflows, LLM for visual reading/drafting or changed layouts. A script entry is a packaged Chrome extension page, not a shell program or remotely evaluated code. Read references/workflows.md for script setup and state invariants. Loading/downloading does not execute. Only follow, publish, save or delete within the user’s explicit task scope. Missing metadata stays unknown; country labels do not establish citizenship or current device. Selectors assume English X; stop and report when a workflow cannot be verified.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: countries (labels), countryField (account|connection|either), sources (any|appstore|android|web), autoFollow, delaySeconds (1–120), maxFollows (1–100).

outputs.name: records
outputs.description: handle, profileUrl, checkedAt, accountBasedIn, connectedVia, dateJoined, status, followStatus, note.

outputs.name: posts
outputs.description: Visible posts with author and source URL.

actions.instructions: Enter the query, read visible results and preserve source URLs. Do not infer unseen results.
Prepare the requested draft. Publish only when explicitly authorized; drafting alone does not authorize publishing.

actions.description: Configure country/source matching and run limits.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: countries (labels), countryField (account|connection|either), sources (any|appstore|android|web), autoFollow, delaySeconds (1–120), maxFollows (1–100).

outputs.name: settings
outputs.description: countries (labels), countryField (account|connection|either), sources (any|appstore|android|web), autoFollow, delaySeconds (1–120), maxFollows (1–100).

actions.instructions: Use the country labels displayed by X. Normalize case/whitespace and US aliases only. Country and source must both match. Web without a country must use account/either. Profile biography is not Account based in. Preserve existing skip records when filters change. Stop before editing settings. Following requires explicit user intent. Defaults: United States App Store, 12 seconds, 20 follow attempts.

actions.description: Scan Home authors, inspect About this account and optionally follow matches.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: countries (labels), countryField (account|connection|either), sources (any|appstore|android|web), autoFollow, delaySeconds (1–120), maxFollows (1–100).

outputs.name: records
outputs.description: handle, profileUrl, checkedAt, accountBasedIn, connectedVia, dateJoined, status, followStatus, note.

outputs.name: run
outputs.description: Saved tab, phase, current visit, scroll offset, follow attempts and status.

actions.instructions: Start from Home (including For you/Following). Reserve each unseen handle persistently BEFORE opening the profile. Open Joined to read About this account; save original visible labels, join date, check time and source URL. Skip saved handles across restarts/filter changes. Use configure-scout rules. Follow only if requested, matching and not already following; persist follow intent BEFORE clicking and count attempts. Unconfirmed follow becomes uncertain and is never automatically clicked again. At the attempt limit or a recognized follow restriction, collect only and mark matches deferred. Return Home and resume scrolling. Pause when tab/window loses focus or an editor/draft is active. Stop on verification, general rate limits, navigation changes or a stalled feed; do not bypass them. See references/workflows.md for recovery phases.

outputs.name: run
outputs.description: Stopped run with saved phase and records.

actions.instructions: Stop the active run and retain records, current visit, scroll offset and attempt counts. Do not clear the skip list.

actions.description: Resume a saved profile visit or restart from Home.

inputs.name: tabId
inputs.description: Original selected X tab or Home tab.

actions.instructions: Reload should reconnect an enabled run without renewing its allowance; stopped scans remain stopped. Resume an unfinished visit in its original tab. Explicit Start from Home abandons a stale visit and begins a new run with saved handles retained. Never repeat a pending/uncertain follow. Scroll restoration after feed refresh is best effort.

actions.description: Show saved country and filter results on author hover.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Enable or disable saved-country hover cards.

outputs.name: account
outputs.description: Checked/unchecked status, country fields, country match and full filter match.

actions.instructions: Read saved records only. Identify the main post author, excluding quoted users. Distinguish unchecked from checked without country data. Color indicates country match; separately show full country-plus-source match. Never visit/follow from hover. Works independently of scanning; disable removes the card immediately.

actions.description: Offer to save confirmed sent text and insert saved text into a draft.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Enable the save offer and picker together.

outputs.name: draft
outputs.description: Inserted draft text; never automatically sent.

actions.instructions: Capture typed text in memory on Post/Reply or Ctrl/Command+Enter. Offer to save only after a fresh sent/published notification AND composer clear/close. Expire unconfirmed attempts at 45 seconds. Exclude quote content, attachments, cancelled/failed sends and ambiguous multi-editor threads. Save only on the user choosing Save text. Normalize NFC, line endings and outer whitespace for duplicate detection, preserving case/internal spacing. Insert at cursor or replace only selection in editable non-password fields. For rich editors use native insertion; if unsupported keep the draft untouched and offer Copy/paste. Never send automatically.

actions.description: Search, add, copy or delete reusable text.

inputs.name: operation
inputs.description: list, save, copy or delete; supply text or id as applicable.

outputs.name: snippets
outputs.description: Persistent id, text and createdAt entries.

actions.instructions: Use the saved-text library. Save only the requested text, deduplicate normalized text, copy only on request, and delete only the selected item. Profile reset must not remove saved text.

actions.description: Search records, current matches and deferred future follows.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Search handle, country, source, status or notes.

outputs.name: records
outputs.description: handle, profileUrl, checkedAt, accountBasedIn, connectedVia, dateJoined, status, followStatus, note.

actions.instructions: Show saved records with search and pagination. Compute matches against current filters. Future follows lists deferred records; listing them must not revisit or automatically follow them.

actions.description: Export all saved records as CSV or JSON backup.

outputs.name: backup
outputs.description: CSV or version 1 JSON with exportedAt and records.

actions.instructions: Export ALL records regardless of search filter. CSV must quote values and neutralize spreadsheet formulas. JSON uses version:1, exportedAt and records. Preserve raw labels and follow status.

actions.description: Merge a Profile Scout JSON backup.

inputs.name: backup
inputs.description: Version 1 JSON backup, at most 100,000 records / 50 MB file.

actions.instructions: Stop scanning. Validate the entire backup before writing; normalize handles and canonical profile URLs. Merge by handle and retain the newer checkedAt. Preserve follow states, settings and saved text. Invalid backups leave existing data intact.

actions.description: Allow failed metadata checks to be visited again.
actions.instructions: Stop scanning. Remove only unavailable/error records without pending, uncertain, followed or requested follow states. Recheck when encountered; do not build an automatic follow queue.

actions.description: Explicitly clear saved profiles and scan progress.
actions.instructions: Stop scanning and obtain explicit intent to reset profiles. Clear progress before records so interruption cannot resume an old visit. Preserve settings, saved text and real X follows. The script displays a confirmation describing the deletion.
